text: showreel qr <dir> writes a QR for each socials entry with a url, at plan::qr_path, and one for session.venue_url when plan::venue_url gives one, at plan::venue_qr_path, in config order. Each file starts with <!--showreel-qr:<url>--> naming the trimmed address it encodes, then the renderer's <svg> element with no XML declaration; and on that reel payload.rs's check raises none of its QR warnings and embeds every one.
